note: Oscoda County has no county-wide zoning; zoning is set by its civil townships (e.g. Mentor, Elmer) and published only as PDF ordinances and maps. No county or city zoning district layer is queryable as an ArcGIS or other service. The county has no incorporated cities. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches found only an Oscoda Charter Township zoning layer, which is in Iosco County, not this county.
